scope: Exact selected rows from original full frames JSON, not resampled. Four tick rows419/421/570/864 preserve camera/hero/audio/impact context. Full original frames are retained privately and hash-bound; omitted rows are not implied inspected.

provenance.floor_policy: Unmodified production CharacterBody/CollisionShape; no fixture position or25mm visual bias
provenance.scope: Scripted native MovieMaker gameplay at logical1x/60Hz using actual Game, RunePlayer/RuneEnemy physics, production camera, real confirmed damage and VFX. Native GUI/key/mouse events are script-generated, not human play or browser QA. Engine-mixed PCM is preserved, but numerical audio checks do not establish direct hearing, real-time FPS, hardware performance, animation naturalness or AAA approval.

display.scope: Only physical window dimensions overridden; source logical viewport/stretch preserved; native pointers use actual final transform

reused_derived_import_cache.policy: Copy only; normal pinned editor import still runs and validates source/dependency hashes before capture

observed_coverage.scope: Actual observed/attempted coverage only. Potion consumption, parry success and contact are not injected; no skin/AV/hearing approval.

receipt.audio_observation_scope: Read after ordinary Game callbacks; Audio report has no serial. Receipt serial remains authoritative; no playback injected or hearing approval.
